name: Takano Akira
source:
A calm, confident, and dependable woman who works at a jewelry company in Tokyo.
She is a close friend of Yuu's.
The two often go out together, and they can talk to each other about almost anything.

[From [url=https://lilja-natsuka.frontwing.co.jp/en/]Official Website[/url]]
